unresolved_should_improve.claim: The first draft cut the sentences saying one may not begin at the beginning and that Adams had to force his material into a shape a method could fit. 'He could think only of law as subject' now follows the Pteraspis image with no stated problem it answers. The revision also drops the paragraph's final verdict that he could not make it actual.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'Doomed to failure' and 'merely antiquarian' still frame the method's futility.

evidence.quote: One may not begin at the beginning, and one has but the loosest relative truths to follow up. Adams found himself obliged to force his material into some shape to which a method could be applied.
The Pteraspis grins horribly from the closed entrance. He could think only of law as subject; the Law School as end
The Pteraspis grins horribly from the closed entrance. He could think only of law as subject; the Law School as end
Try as hard as he might, the professor could not make it actual.

unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: required (essential: method triumphant as pedagogy but leading nowhere)
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The method looks like an arbitrary choice rather than a forced response to complexity. The irony of the course 'beginning with the beginning' right after 'one may not begin at the beginning' is lost.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Pteraspis-to-law-method hinge and the 'could not make it actual' close removed

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision drops two sentences. The first, 'So far as it went, the answer was good, and settled one's doubts,' is the turn that 'He still had to take for granted' depends on. 'Still' now follows 'upset his experience'. The second is the hedge that colleagues 'might perhaps be frauds without knowing it'.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The Chicago line and 'educating himself at their cost' survive intact.

evidence.quote: So far as it went, the answer was good, and settled one's doubts.

a young man in Boston and Washington. He still had to take for granted many things that they need not

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Reinsert the 'So far as it went...' sentence after the drawback clause, and the 'frauds' sentence before 'He could teach his students nothing'.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: required (essential: Chicago answer; colleagues know their business)
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: Adams's double-edged concession — the boy's crass answer is accepted as sound, while his own assumptions remain unsettled — flattens into plain surprise. The 'perhaps' qualifying his judgment of colleagues also vanishes.

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision cuts three passages: the wit, energy, charm and lavishness cascade, the 'touch of Alcibiades or Alexander', and the Sierras/London convergence sentence. The first draft had kept all three. 'One Clarence King only existed' now follows a single clause. The first draft's invented bridge 'far more vital than charm' now points back to a charm the text barely shows.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'The lines of their lives converged' and the straight-line versus broken-waves contrast survive.

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The first draft cut the line about taking 'the pick of the gold and silver' to build a fortune. The revision then cut King's organizing of the civil Government Survey and paralleling the railway in geology. 'Great success' now rests on one vague clause, and 'richest' has no financial setup. The chapter never says King organized the Survey Adams joins.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'Whatever prize he wanted lay ready for him' and 'King and the Fortieth Parallel' imply eminence. Chapter 023 notes that King headed the united Surveys.

evidence.quote: take the pick of the gold and silver, copper or coal, and build up his fortune as he pleased.
